answer: Two onyx stones with the same weight stamp in the garden registry belong to one operator, and both are voided at settlement. Each identity plants one stone in its own garden plot at registration, backed by a 400,000 POA bond, and a plume audit weighs every stone at epoch end. A matched pair burns both rewards, passes both bonds to honest peers, and fines the operator 258,000 POA per fake. One fake costs 658,000 POA, and five fakes cost 3,290,000 POA before any payout clears.
